objective: Proof attempt: bound the linked pairs of every native gadget of the six open knots, for example by the square of the largest off-diagonal value, which would give hub ratio at most 2 for all gadgets and so no amplification; or find a counterexample. Gate: a proof or a counterexample; otherwise record the obstruction.
status: Proved by SOFT-HUB-20261024-001C-P001: every tree gadget of a non-windable knot satisfies F(u)F(u-bar) <= s_u + F(u + e_i)F(u-bar) + F(u)F(u-bar + e_i), by a one-sided flip of terminal i's arm along the tree route, so tree gadgets of the open knots have hub ratio at most 3 (and reach 12/11). With a cycle the arm is not determined (an explicit seven-knot collision), so the bound for all gadgets remains a conjecture, supported on every gadget tested.
title: A bound on hubs for the open knots
